name: Furron
summary: Furron has seven territories. The route starts at Whiskerhold and ends at Whiskspire.
role: Select a territory that the contractors control as your spawn location. Defend captured territories to keep the forward spawn locations.
fun_facts: Whiskerhold is part of the map but does not count toward the reclaimed-territory objective.
Rush uses only Furrow. It does not use the full route.
